title: Two-step drop
description: Price peaks at 69,808 an hour in (12 Jun 17:00); the rest is the incomplete leg down to 66,860. Inside it are two downswings. The 67,520 low (12 Jun 19:00) bounces to 68,505 and is closed below at 13 Jun 03:00 (67,450); the 67,314 low (04:00) bounces to 67,812 and is closed below at 15:00 (66,420).
